name: node_modules
description: JavaScript project dependencies. Regenerated by `npm install`; safe to delete for projects you are not actively working on.

name: npm cache
description: Package download cache. npm re-downloads on demand.

name: Yarn cache
description: Package download cache. Yarn re-downloads on demand.

name: pnpm store
description: Content-addressed package store. pnpm re-downloads on demand; active projects hard-link into it, so prefer `pnpm store prune`.

name: pip cache
description: Python package download cache. pip re-downloads on demand.

name: uv cache
description: Python package cache for uv. Re-downloads on demand.

name: Python virtual environment
description: Project virtualenv. Recreate with `pip install -r requirements.txt`; safe to delete for inactive projects.

name: Conda package cache
description: Downloaded conda packages. `conda clean --all` reclaims this the official way.

name: Cargo registry cache
description: Rust crate downloads. cargo re-downloads on demand.

name: Rust build output
description: Cargo build artifacts. `cargo build` regenerates them; safe to delete for inactive projects.

name: Go build cache
description: Compiler cache. Rebuilt on next `go build`.

name: Go module cache
description: Downloaded module sources shared across projects. Restored on next build; `go clean -modcache` is the official way.

name: Gradle caches
description: JVM build caches and wrapper distributions. Regenerated on next build.

name: Maven local repository
description: Downloaded Java dependencies shared across projects. Re-downloaded on next build, which can be slow.

name: NuGet package cache
description: .NET package cache shared across solutions. Restored on next build, but restores can be slow.

name: Deno cache
description: Module and transpile cache. Re-fetched on demand.

name: Bun install cache
description: Package download cache. Bun re-downloads on demand.

name: node-gyp headers
description: Node.js headers downloaded for building native addons. Re-downloaded on demand.

name: Electron build caches
description: Downloaded Electron binaries used by build tooling. Re-downloaded on demand.

name: VS Code caches
description: Editor caches. Rebuilt on next launch.

name: User temp folder
description: Per-user temporary files. Files in use are locked and skipped automatically.

name: Windows temp folder
description: System-wide temporary files. Clearing needs admin rights; files in use are locked.

name: Windows Update downloads
description: Downloaded update payloads. Clear via Disk Cleanup > Windows Update Cleanup, not manual deletion.

name: Windows log files
description: Servicing and component logs (CBS etc.). Old logs are safe to clear; needs admin.

name: Crash dumps
description: Minidumps written when programs or Windows crash. Safe to clear unless you are actively debugging.

name: Windows Error Reporting dumps
description: Crash dumps kept for diagnostics. Safe to clear unless you are actively debugging a crash.

name: Installer Package Cache
description: Kept by Visual Studio and other installers for repair/uninstall. Deleting breaks repair — moving it to another drive with a junction is the safe way to reclaim the space.

name: Windows Search index
description: Rebuildable from Settings > Searching Windows > Advanced Indexing Options > Rebuild.

name: Thumbnail cache
description: Explorer thumbnails; regenerated as you browse. Files are locked while Explorer runs — use Disk Cleanup > Thumbnails.

name: Internet cache (legacy)
description: IE/WebView legacy web caches. WebCacheV*.dat is locked while Windows runs — use Disk Cleanup.

name: Browser cache
description: Chromium-based browser HTTP and code caches. Regenerated while browsing.

name: Firefox cache
description: HTTP cache. Regenerated while browsing.

name: Discord caches
description: Media and code caches. Regenerated on use.

name: Slack caches
description: Message and media caches. Regenerated on use.

name: Spotify song cache
description: Streamed-song cache. Re-streams on demand; size is also capped in Spotify's own settings.

name: Adobe media cache
description: Premiere/After Effects preview renders. Regenerated when projects reopen.

name: GPU shader caches
description: Compiled shader caches (NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, D3D, Steam). Rebuilt on next game launch at the cost of brief stutter.

name: NVIDIA driver downloads
description: Downloaded driver installers. Safe once the driver is installed.

name: Epic Games Launcher web cache
description: Launcher UI caches. Regenerated on next launch.

name: Unity caches
description: Asset Store downloads and GI cache. Re-downloaded/regenerated on demand.

name: iPhone/iPad backups
description: Device backups made by iTunes/Apple Devices. Large and precious — only delete backups of devices you no longer own, or move them to another drive.

name: Docker Desktop virtual disk
description: Docker's WSL2 disk grows but never shrinks on its own. Reclaim with `docker system prune` then compacting, not by deleting the file.

name: WSL distro virtual disk
description: A Linux distro's entire disk in one file; it never shrinks automatically. Clean inside the distro, then compact with `wsl --manage <distro> --set-sparse` or diskpart.

name: Previous Windows installation
description: Left over from a feature update; enables rollback. Remove via Disk Cleanup or Storage Sense, not manual deletion.

name: Delivery Optimization cache
description: Windows Update peer-sharing cache. Clear via Settings > Storage > Temporary files.

name: Downloaded installers
description: Setup executables and ISOs in Downloads are usually dead weight once installed.
